links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT-4o responses to olecranon fracture patient questions (FKGL, SMOG, GFI, FRE)
links.effect: Mean FRE 62.00 ± 5.12; mean FKGL, SMOG, GFI 9.23, 8.42, 9.37, corresponding to ninth-grade reading level, exceeding recommended levels for patient comprehension.
links.quote: The mean FRE was 62.00 ± 5.12, and mean FKGL, SMOG, and GFI values (9.23, 8.42, 9.37) corresponded to a ninth-grade reading level.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, quality (DISCERN/GQS), and readability of ChatGPT-4o responses to patient FAQs about olecranon fractures without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
